info.title: EC Usage Statistics
info.description:
The EC Usage Statistics API allows you to query Morningstar usage tracking information logged by EC components and US APIs. Users with the relevant permissions can fetch usage statistics for client namespaces.


You can use the API to:

* Retrieve usage statistics.
* Retrieve usage statistics in timeseries format.
* Generate reports in Excel format.
* Manage and create objects representing company entitlements.


The API queries the following resources:

|Resource|Description|
|:----|:----|
|`statistics`| Objects that represent usage tracking information for components and APIs. You can retrieve `statistics` resources for a specific namespace, tool and time period. |
|`timeseries`| Objects that represent usage statistics in timeseries format. You can retrieve `timeseries` resources for a specific namespace, tool and time period. |
|`reports`| Objects that represent an instance of a usage statistics report for a specific namespace. Reports are available in Excel format.|
|`company-entitlements`| Objects that represent a record of a company and the namespaces it is entitled for. You can retrieve, create, update, and delete `company-entitlements` resources.|

get.summary: Get a statistics resource for a namespace, tool and time period
get.description: Get the latest statistics for the specified namespace, tool and time period. Specify the `date` parameter to get statistics for that date.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Get statistics for this time period

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Get statistics logged for this date. For month or quarter this is the end date for the period. If omitted returns the latest available statistics.

200.description: Statistics for a namespace and tool over a time period (day, month or quarter)

schema.description: Statistics for a namespace, tool and date

securities.description: A breakdown of securities (by security identifier) and how often each was logged

count.description: The number of times the loaded event was triggered

type.description: The event type - timed, count or breakdown

source.description: The component that was the source of the event

count.description: The number of times the event was triggered

breakdown.description: A breakdown of the primary values for the event and how many times each was logged

mean.description: For timed events, the mean load time

median.description: For timed events, the median load time

percentile95.description: For timed events, the 95th percentile load time

method.description: For 'dataLoaded' events, the method of the call

url.description: For 'dataLoaded' events, the URL that was called

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

get.summary: Get statistics in timeseries format for a namespace, tool and time period
get.description:
Get latest statistics in timeseries format for the specified namespace, tool and time period.

. You can specify a date range for the query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Get statistics for this time period

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Get statistics logged on or after this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Get statistics logged on or before this date

schema.description: Statistics in timeseries format for a namespace, tool and date

date.description: The date or end date for the time period

count.description: The number of times the loaded event was triggered

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

parameters.name: namespaces
parameters.description: Get statistics for a namespace or comma-separated list of namespaces

200.description: Excel report file containing monthly and quarterly usage stats and top security data

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

get.description: Get company entitlements for the company specified in the `companyId` parameter or for the entitlementIds specified in the `entitlementIds` parameter

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

post.description:
Create a company entitlement for the company and namespaces specified in the request body. A namespace in an entitlement can be:

 * a complete namespace, e.g. `abc.opp.screener`, to give the companyId access to that namespace only
 * a partial namespace, e.g. `abc.opp`, to give the companyId access to all namespaces that begin with that prefix, e.g. `abc.opp.screener` and `abc.opp.xray`

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

409.description: There is a request conflict with the target resource

get.description: Get the company entitlement specified by the `entitlementId` parameter

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

put.description: Overwrite the company entitlement specified by the `entitlementId` parameter. The namespaces listed in the request body will replace the current namespaces for this entitlement. The `companyId` for this entitlement will not be updated.

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist

delete.description: Delete the company entitlement specified by the `entitlementId` parameter.

401.description: The user is not authorised to perform this operation

404.description: The requested resource does not exist
